english.title: Make false statement in providing information required under section 51(2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in providing information as required under section 51(2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006, made a statement that you knew to be, or recklessly made a statement that was, false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATEMENT AND PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 51(4) and (5) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in providing information as required under s 51(2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
made a statement that you knew to be/were recklessly making a statement that was

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(ii) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(iii) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).
